entities.name: PMID:27514406
observations: 2016 study titled “Ercc1 Deficiency Promotes Tumorigenesis and Increases Cisplatin Sensitivity in a Tp53 Context-Specific Manner.”

entities.name: ERCC1-TP53 context effect
observations: In a Kras-driven mouse lung adenocarcinoma model, Ercc1 deficiency in Tp53-deficient tumors was reported to promote a more aggressive tumor phenotype and enhance cisplatin sensitivity; retrieved summary lacked exact genotypes and quantitative effect sizes.

entities.name: ERCC1
observations: ERCC1 deficiency was investigated in the reported Kras-driven mouse lung adenocarcinoma model.

entities.name: TP53
observations: The reported tumor phenotype and cisplatin response associated with Ercc1 deficiency depended on Tp53 context.
